description: Crypto, token, consensus, file, and smart contract services for a Hiero based network
readme_summary: Implementation of the Platform and the services offered by nodes in the Hedera public network. - _platform-sdk/_ - the basic Platform – documentation - _hedera-node/_ - implementation of Hedera services on the Platform – documentation Refer to the Hedera Architecture and Design for an architectural overview of the Hedera Services project. Refer to the Quickstart Guide for how to work with this project. If you have a question on how to use the product, please see our support guide. Contributions are welcome.
